name: seedfast
description: Seeds a PostgreSQL database with realistic, relationally valid test data from a plain-English scope. Bundles the Seedfast MCP server and the plan-before-run workflow that keeps seeding safe.

api_key.title: Seedfast API key
api_key.description: Created at https://seedfa.st/dashboard. Starts with sfk_. Required for planning and running seedings; schema introspection and connection tests work without it.

runs_db.title: Run history file (optional)
runs_db.description: Absolute path to a SQLite file where plans and run history are kept. Leave blank to keep them in memory, which means they disappear when the MCP server exits.
